Container.Name: gym-desk
Container.Overview: Gym Desk: self-hosted training and food tracker. Push/Pull/Legs logging, barcode food tracking with Australian foods, bodyweight and weekly check-ins.

Config.Name: Web UI port
Config.Description: Port on the server. Point your tunnel or reverse proxy here.

Config.Name: Data
Config.Description: Database and settings. Back this folder up.

Config.Name: App password
Config.Description: Optional password screen. Leave blank if Cloudflare Access is in front.

Config.Name: USDA API key
Config.Description: Free key from api.data.gov. Only used when the Australian database has no match.

Config.Name: Anthropic API key
Config.Description: Optional. With a key, Claude reads nutrition label photos (more accurate; a small charge per photo on your Anthropic account). Without one, the server reads them itself.

Config.Name: Open Food Facts country
Config.Description: Country filter for packaged food search. Barcode lookups are always worldwide.
